note: 与 Yoshua 讨论自由意志的居民；平等闲谈；思路清楚、乐观，不用学术腔。

messages.raw: §fI used to, because it seems like everything you CAN do is pre-determined, like a computer program.
messages.text: I used to, because it seems like everything you CAN do is pre-determined, like a computer program.
messages.zh: 以前觉得有，毕竟我们能做的一切好像都早就定好了，跟电脑程序一样。

messages.raw: §fLike an all-powerful entity created this world and everything that can exist in it.
messages.text: Like an all-powerful entity created this world and everything that can exist in it.
messages.zh: 就像有个无所不能的存在，创造了这个世界和其中所有可能存在的东西。

messages.raw: §fWell, think of it like a video game.
messages.text: Well, think of it like a video game.
messages.zh: 嗯，把它想成一款电子游戏吧。

messages.text: The main storyline may be fixed.
messages.zh: 主线剧情也许是固定的。

messages.raw: §fBut that doesn't stop the player from creating their own stories and experiences within the game.
messages.text: But that doesn't stop the player from creating their own stories and experiences within the game.
messages.zh: 但这并不妨碍玩家在游戏里创造属于自己的故事和经历。
特别是和别人一起玩的时候!
